scope: Simple classroom AI tools proven globally and possible paid use in India. Hardware is one lane among paper, phone, audio, assessment, teaching, parent communication, and accessibility tools.

discovery: Agent Reach Exa web search until free HTTP 429 quota
Agent Reach YouTube via yt-dlp: title shortlist, transcript, then comments
Specific known-page and primary-source web search after Exa quota

evidence_levels.A: Independent primary record for its precise claim. For a commercial claim this means a public purchase, disbursement, or acquisition; official counts, policies and studies do not imply revenue.
evidence_levels.B: Published price plus named use; paid customer count remains unknown.
evidence_levels.C: Vendor adoption claim, downloads, grant-funded use, anecdote, or test; does not prove buyer payment.

limitations: No Indian school or coaching-centre operator interview or private invoice inspected.
Some India-facing AI grading and question-paper sites appear newly launched; supplier metrics and testimonials were not treated as independent proof.
Two Class Saathi video testimonials had readable transcripts but zero comments; teacher-tool comments were mainly price and free-tier questions, not buyer evidence.
Global US prices are not India price forecasts.
